# Kaggle and Runpod brand artwork

The original downloaded SVGs in this folder are official third-party brand assets. They are retained as source references and are not covered by SuperIntelligence’s MIT license. Their owners retain artwork and trademark rights; inclusion does not imply endorsement or grant a trademark license.

- **Kaggle:** [official website wordmark](https://www.kaggle.com/static/images/site-logo.svg), with [brand guidelines](https://www.kaggle.com/brand-guidelines). The icon uses the unchanged first, lowercase-k subpath and its original cyan. The full downloaded source remains here for verification.
- **Runpod:** [official brand kit](https://www.runpod.io/brandkit). The source SVG is the black lockup linked by that page. The icon uses its unchanged cube-emblem path; Color applies the page’s official #5D29F0 purple. The original full lockup remains here for verification. The kit also supplies unmodified white, black, and purple icons and states restrictions on altering brand artwork. SuperIntelligence’s isometric and palette variants are unofficial identification illustrations, not approved brand assets.

`training-platforms.mjs` stores the extracted native geometry without tracing or redrawing. `sources.json` records original URLs, retrieval date, SHA-256 checksums, and transformations. The default viewBox is tightened around each compact symbol; original symbol proportions are preserved. Refer to the original brand sources when unmodified artwork is required.
